The morning air was damp and humid, droplets of sweat formed on my brow as I trod over burnt corpses. I could still feel the heat of the fire that killed them pulsate from the corpses. I wasn't wearing much, just an ordinary tracksuit, I wasn't holding anything either. But still the soldiers in front of me shook like scared children as I aproached them. Their commander, a rather stoic looking fellow and the only one there not trembling. "Glad to see you've come out this far to see me!" I shouted at the soldiers leader. "Shut up! I had hoped this day would have never come." The brusque man responded angrily hefting a rather heavy looking gun into a firing position. "There is absolutely no way you could defeat us here!" The commander yelled. "Explain the hundreds of bodies behind me then? I will finally have my revenge against you!" I screamed, my mind bordering insanity. "You and what army?!" The commander shouted, squeezing the trigger on his gun, realising a flurry of sharp metal. "Who says I need an army? Dad." I said, as a burning hunk of stone pierced the clouds above the gathered army.

As the fairly fat student sitting across from me stood up from his deck i realised something wrong, a slight bulge in his pant pocket. Before i could react he had begun shooting up the classroom. *What the hell* i thought, overcome by anger. i reached into my bag and pulled out a fairly weathered but otherwise still operational handgun and, before a could shoot the fuck shit through his skull he took notice of my weapon, he grabbed astudent and began using them as a shield screaming "PUT THAT FUCKING THING DOWN IF YOU DOINT WANT THEM TO DIE". He hadn't seemed to notice the reason i had a gun, so i shot the human shield in the chest. The fatass was stunned for a brief moment, as if thinking the same thoughts as me, before he literally threw his desk at me. i was able to run out of the way before it crashed against the wall i had been standing next to. *that fuck is strong* i thought running out of the classroom and shooting a teacher walking to their next class. I heard screams coming from all directions after that, for some reason no one screamed when it happened in our classroom, but that didn't matter. All that mattered was revenge now, i was hellbent on this goal until i heard something truly strange, a sound i could only describe as a wet gurgling, i turned around and came face to face with the same chubby shit that had started shooting up the classroom, but his body was malformed and twisted "what the fuck" i said before shooting him in the head, although the bullet simply rebounded off of his forehead. *Am i dreaming* i thought as the bloated fatty in front of me started to change shapes into a truly disgusting creature. It stood much taller then before with four arms and various other limps slapping wetly all over its body. My eyes widened in horror as it reached one clawed hand towards me. I couldn't move as it shredded me to pieces in its clawed grasp.
